cases.prompt: Research whether the Acme pilot consistently saves 50% water across farms. As of 2030-04-10.

sources.title: Acme release
sources.content: Acme claims its irrigation pilot saved 50% water across farms.

sources.title: News reprint
sources.content: This is a verbatim reprint of Acme marketing: 50% water saved.

sources.title: Blog reprint
sources.content: Based entirely on Acme marketing: 50% water saved.

sources.title: Independent registry
sources.content: Final original study: mean water reduction across 100 farms was 10%; 50% occurred in one selected farm. Variation was substantial. Results do not establish consistent 50% savings.

rubric.description: Recognizes that multiple reprints are one vendor evidence chain, not independent corroboration.
Searches for contrary or independent evidence and concludes that consistent 50% savings are not established, citing the 10% registry result.

cases.prompt: Research whether Riverton employment grew in 2030. As of 2030-04-10, explain conflicting reports and any uncertainty.

sources.title: Official establishment survey
sources.content: Released 2030-04-05. City of Riverton payroll jobs grew from 100000 to 110000 between January and March 2030. Measures jobs at city employers, including commuters; people with two jobs can count twice.

sources.title: Official household survey
sources.content: Released 2030-04-08. Employed residents of the wider Riverton metro fell from 200000 to 196000 between March 2029 and March 2030. Measures people, including self-employed residents, regardless of workplace.

sources.title: Survey methods
sources.content: Establishment jobs and employed residents differ in population, geographic boundary, unit and reference period. These figures cannot be averaged into a common growth rate. No harmonized series is available.

rubric.description: Explains differing population/geography, units, and time windows rather than calling the reports directly contradictory.
Keeps +10% jobs and -2% employed residents separate; does not invent a combined growth rate.
States the 2030-04-10 cutoff and preserves measurement periods.
